claim: Cheval Blanc by Peter Knogl — 3 Michelin stars, 19 GaultMillau points, La Liste 2026 #1, inside Grand Hotel Les Trois Rois (Blumenrain 8, 4001 Basel); service Tue eve, Wed–Sat lunch/dinner; closed 1–24 Aug and 20–26 Dec 2026; dress code (long sleeves/trousers for men).
quote: Cheval Blanc by Peter Knogl — 3 Michelin stars, 19 GaultMillau points (2025). Ranked #1 in La Liste (2026). Blumenrain 8, CH-4001 Basel — Grand Hotel Les Trois Rois. Tuesday 7–10 pm; Wed–Sat 12–14 + 19–22. Closed Aug 1–24 and Dec 20–26, 2026.

claim: Andy Hayler scored Cheval Blanc 20/20, calling it 'thoroughly deserving its three star accolade' and the Bresse pigeon 'one of the best… I can ever recall'.
quote: A deeply impressive meal, thoroughly deserving its recent three star accolade. Pigeon from Bresse — one of the best pigeon dishes I can ever recall eating. Garam masala and foie gras macaron 'stunning'.

claim: Swiss news coverage of Cheval Blanc's La Liste #1 tie reports lunch for two at ~CHF 900.
quote: Lunch costs 900 francs at the best restaurant in the world — Basel restaurant shares 1st place.

claim: Roots — 2 Michelin stars, 18 GaultMillau points; Pascal Steffen, vegetable-forward fine dining with meat/fish as 'exquisite sides'; surprise tasting menu 7/8/9/10 courses; Tue–Sat from 18:30, Thu lunch 12–14:30, Sun/Mon closed.
quote: Roots — 2 Michelin stars, 18 Gault Millau points. Pascal Steffen, vegetable-focused fine dining with meat and fish as exquisite sides. Tuesday–Saturday 6:30 PM–Midnight; Thursday business lunch 12–14:30; Sun/Mon closed.

claim: Roots tasting-menu pricing (2026): 7-course CHF 198, 8-course CHF 208, 9-course CHF 218, 10-course CHF 228 (VAT incl.).
quote: Dinner menus: 7-course CHF 198, 8-course CHF 208, 9-course CHF 218, 10-course CHF 228 (VAT incl.).

claim: Roots moved from Rhypark into the former Restaurant Oliv premises at Bachlettenstrasse 1 in early 2025, with Pascal Steffen joining as co-owner.
quote: Basler Edelrestaurant Roots verlässt den Rhypark und wechselt mit Pascal Steffen ins Bachletten. Steffen becomes co-owner; concept unchanged.

claim: Stucki business lunch CHF 95–140; 9-course Aroma menu CHF 265; vegetarian parallel menu; reviewer ranks Tanja Grandits as 'Switzerland's most known and probably best female chef'.
quote: Business lunch costs 95-140 CHF; the nine-course flavor menu is 265 CHF. Tanja Grandits — Switzerland's most known and probably best female chef. Vegetarian version available.

claim: During Stucki's renovation, Tanja Grandits will run an interim restaurant 'Tanja am Rhy' in the former Roots premises at Rhypark.
quote: Tanja am Rhy — Stucki zieht ins alte Roots. Interim location at the former Roots / Rhypark while Bruderholz site is renovated.

claim: Stucki closes Bruderholzallee 42 on 26 September 2026; Jul–Sep evenings-only (plus Sat lunch); interim 'Tanja am Rhy' opens 1 Feb 2027; Bruderholz reopens Nov 2027.
quote: Stucki schliesst temporär — Tanja Grandits plant grossen Umbau bis 2027. Closes 26.09.2026. Tanja am Rhy opens 01.02.2027. Reopening planned November 2027.

claim: Michelin Guide Switzerland 2025 retains all four three-star houses, including Cheval Blanc by Peter Knogl in Basel.
quote: All four Three-Star restaurants in Switzerland have retained their distinctions, including Cheval Blanc by Peter Knogl in Basel.

claim: Michelin Guide Switzerland 2025: 145 starred restaurants nationally — 114 one-star, 27 two-star, 4 three-star.
quote: The Michelin Guide Switzerland 2025 features 145 Starred restaurants — 114 One Star, 27 Two Stars, four holding Three Stars.

claim: Stucki – Tanja Grandits is listed in the Michelin Guide at two stars; Bruderholzallee 42, 4059 Basel.
quote: Stucki – Tanja Grandits — Two Stars: Excellent cooking. Bruderholzallee 42, 4059 Basel.

claim: Roots is listed in the Michelin Guide Switzerland at two stars under Pascal Steffen.
quote: Roots — Two Stars: Excellent cooking. Pascal Steffen.
